text: Please open the practice card at Checking the half note without guessing. Don’t revise or create a page; I just want to get back to that step.

I can't move your view, but the step is in the book: open **Practice card: two bars, count the empty beat** and go to the section **Checking the half note without guessing**. Nothing on the page has changed, your picking-hand line included.

The section, so you can start from here:

- Metronome at **60**. Say "1 2 3 4" on the clicks first, no guitar.
- Bar 2: **G** on a click, say **"two"** on the next click with the hand still, **E** on the click after that, **C** on the next.
- The only question: **does E land on a click?**

Come back with one word: early, on, or late.
